lines.en: I crawl forward on the ground.
My arms drag my body along.
My antlers carve a groove in the soil.

lines.zh: 我一步一步地爬起来又倒下
lines.en: I rise a step and fall again.
My bones keep creaking.
I prop myself on my elbows.
I work my way to a tree.
I push forward with my head low.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很重，带着杂音
lines.en: My breathing is heavy and ragged.

lines.zh: 我抓住一根树根拉自己
lines.en: I pull myself along a root.
I stop and hold myself up.
I lie on the ground, shoulders moving.
I have not stood in a long while.
My fingers dig into the dirt.
I struggle in the dirt.
My antlers are stuck in the soil.
I lift my head, then let it fall.

lines.zh: 我听见自己的骨头发响
lines.en: I hear my own bones.
I lie still and breathe.
There is a drag mark behind me.
I am counting my own breaths.
My face is in the dirt.
I push myself up a little.
My fingers twitch.
I will not just lie here.
You are standing; I am still down.
I raise my head to you.

lines.zh: 你看我这样，是不是觉得完了
lines.en: Seeing me like this, do you think it is over?
This body can still struggle.
My fingers are clawing the dirt.
I push myself up slowly.
Do not come too near.
I have not stopped breathing yet.
Look at my face.
I will tear this face off.

lines.zh: 你听见过骨头互相磨吗
lines.en: Have you heard bone grind on bone?
I am on the ground, but I do not bow.
I am getting up.
Take a few steps back.
I am not finished.
I am watching your feet.
I have a grip on the ground.
I sink a little lower.
My shoulder bone has slipped.
I hold myself up.
That pressure hurt.
My fingers miss their grip once.
My breathing grows louder.
I sink a little into the dirt.
My mask cracks further.
I raise my head.
I am still down in the dirt.
I do not want food.
What do you mean to do with that?
I cannot even open my mouth.
I have no use for any of it.
I only want to stand up.
You keep that thing.
That is no use to me.
My fingers cannot hold it.
I look, then let my head drop.
Take it off to one side.
You kicked me.
I am knocked onto my back.
I push up, then fall.
Do not step on me.
You stepped on my hand.
I do not care about that.
My spine brushes against your leg.
Back away a little.
I cannot even stand.
Such things are far from me now.
Do not bring that up again.
I have only this much left.
I cannot even shake my head.
I sink down to the ground.
My mind is blank.
Leave me be a moment.
My fingers dig into the dirt.
I do not say a word.
I cannot hold anything.
It falls from my hand.
I squeeze it once.
It lands beside my face.
I glance at it sidelong.
Whose it is, I do not plan to return it.
I take it in my teeth.
This is of no use.
I tuck it under myself.
I crawl along dragging it.
You are close enough now.

lines.zh: 我的手指已经扣住土了
lines.en: My fingers have taken hold of the soil.
I am pushing myself up.

lines.zh: 我的印记已经在你身上
lines.en: My mark is already upon you.
I lift my head, and my eyes are bright.
Do you want to see my face?
I have wanted this far too long.
I am not finished.
My fingers are closing.
I start counting at three.
I will tear this face off clean.
You stand right where you are.

lines.zh: 我的角顶到了你的胸口。
lines.en: My antlers reach your chest.
Under the mask, I am still breathing.
Do you hear my bones?
I am coming for you.
I push myself up, little by little.
My hands are braced in the dirt.
You retreat, I follow slowly.
I am not fully up yet.
Every bone in me is creaking.

lines.zh: 我一边挣一边数你的脚步
lines.en: I struggle and count your steps.
I am waiting for my strength.
My antlers have lifted.
Wait a little longer.
There is still some distance.
I am down, and the mask is still on.
I have risen a little higher.
I will not fall this time.

lines.zh: 我撑着地面，抬起头看你。
lines.en: I brace against the ground and lift my head.
Everything on my side is ready.
I tear off the mask.
My face is showing.
I am among the living now.
I push myself up a little more.
Right at this moment.
I seize your leg.
My fingers dig into your flesh.
You are dragged to your knees.
I bite down on your shoulder.
I fall again.
I pull you down with me.
My antlers catch on you.

lines.zh: 这一下我用了最后一点力
lines.en: That used the last of my strength.
A bone in me has snapped.
You pulled free of my grip.
I gape, unable to make a sound.
I push off the ground and rise again.

lines.zh: 我的手指扣进你的护腕。
lines.en: My fingers dig into your bracer.
I am still down on this ground.
I have waited far too long for this.
I push myself up off the ground.

lines.zh: 地上有一具正在动的身体
lines.en: A body on the ground is moving.
My mask is cracked.
The first thing to move is my fingers.
I lay there a long while.
Snow lies heavy on my back.
I lift my head, and my neck cracks.

lines.zh: 我撑着地面，还没直起腰
lines.en: I brace on the ground, not yet upright.
I pull my antlers out of the soil.
I leave a groove in the ground.
I see you standing there.
My knees leave the earth first.
I tear that face away.
I will not fall again.

lines.zh: 我抓着地面，一寸一寸地起
lines.en: I pull myself up, inch by inch.

lines.zh: 一阵阵白气从我嘴里出来
lines.en: White breath comes from my mouth.
I never truly died.
I am standing before you.
When I look up, the sky is dark.
I appear before you.
Fire scorches my back.
I roll down the bank again.
Muddy water fills my mouth.
An arrow pins my shoulder.

lines.zh: 魔法一直烧进我骨头里
lines.en: Magic burns right into my bones.
I am so hungry even crawling is hard.
The earth is gone.
